Settings

Coaches

Coaches who make an account with the app link appear here with the age groups they asked for. Pick the teams to give them and press Approve — then they can see the Club library and save work in those teams only.

Club roster

Coaches you expect. With an email, they’re let straight in to their teams when they sign up with it. Without one, their teams are ticked for you when someone with that name signs up.

Add coaches

One coach a line — name, age groups, and email if you have it. For example:
Sam Smith U14 sam@email.com

Sync with your HUFC account

Sign in with the same email and password on your computer, iPhone and iPad, and they all keep the same sessions, lineups, pre-games and squads. It still works with no signal — everything catches up when you’re back online.

Which age groups do you coach?

Tap every group you coach. My folder shows all of their sessions, matchday lineups and practices together, and you can change any of it. Every other age group’s work is in the Club library to view, print or copy.

Game time & player stats

Minutes come from each matchday lineup — the starting team in each half and the subs. Each team is counted on its own, from that team’s lineups only. Within a team, players are matched by name, so spell names the same way each week. % is the share of the minutes in the games they were named in the squad.
